facts.text: MOSH uses technology readiness levels as stage gates; TRL4 is a laboratory bench-testing phase covering the ISO/TS 21815-2 interface test, log keeping, self-diagnostics, radio spectrum approval and electromagnetic compatibility, with a requirement for no false interventions and false warnings.
facts.quote: At TRL4, the laboratory phase, a system is bench-tested: the ISO/TS 21815-2 interface test, log keeping, self-diagnostics, radio spectrum approval and electromagnetic compatibility, with the requirement of "no false interventions and false warnings" [Chapters 3, 7].

facts.text: At MOSH TRL7, a system is verified on machines at a representative site under a stage-gate specification dated 20 January 2026.
